The '''45-T InfoCore''' was a [[subspace tight-beam transmission core]] manufactured by [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]].<ref name="Journal" /> The [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace relay system]] frequently used by [[Spy/Legends|spies]] to send tight beam communications.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|103|InfoCore}}</ref>
